subject: [PATCH v3 4/5] NFSD: report registerable programs in the listener_set reply

2026-09-15.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NFSD (Network File System Daemon) to report registerable programs in the listener_set reply when a caller owns rpcbind. The reply includes the programs and versions that nfsd would have registered, as well as the listeners to register them for. This information is sent only when the request asked for it, preserving compatibility with older callers. The patch also removes unnecessary code and optimizes memory allocation for large listener sets.
